bi_weekly_hw_absenteeism._note: Bi-weekly count of ALL staff (permanent + non-permanent) present by cadre. Column 1 is an unnamed index column.

permanent_hw_absenteeism._note: Bi-weekly count of PERMANENT staff present by cadre.

facility_details._note: Static reference table: one row per facility with classification, location, and administrative metadata.

ls_facilities_list._note: Master list of all LS-enrolled facilities with their IDs and administrative assignments.

dhis2_master_lookup._note: DHIS2 organisation unit lookup table for linking LS facility IDs to the national DHIS2 hierarchy.

scm_em_available._note: Bi-weekly availability of essential medicines per facility — binary yes/no per medicine.

scm_em_stock_balance._sheet_name: SCM- EM Minimun stock & Stock Balance Pattern Data
scm_em_stock_balance._note: Bi-weekly minimum stock level (MS) and stock balance (SB) per essential medicine per facility. Columns ending in _MS are minimum stock levels (integer), _SB are stock balances (integer).

scm_vaccines_available._note: Bi-weekly availability of vaccines per facility — binary yes/no per vaccine type.

scm_vaccines_stock_balance._note: Bi-weekly minimum stock level (MS) and stock balance (SB) per vaccine type per facility. Columns ending in _MS are minimum stock levels (integer), _SB are stock balances (integer).

bi_weekly_reason_absenteeism._note: Bi-weekly count of absenteeism reasons per health worker cadre. Each column is formatted as 'Cadre_Reason'. Cadres: Medical Officers (Doctors), Nurses/Midwives, CHOs, JCHEWs, CHEWs, Medical Lab Technician, Environmental Health Officers, Medical Record Officers, Pharmacy Technicians.
